value.name: Miles sneaks into the mansion
value.description: Miles quietly enters the mansion and searches for Marylin, moving warily through the dark interior.
evidence: We hear a key scrape in the lock. The front door swings open onto a dark foyer as Miles tiptoes in.
MILES (Whispers) Marylin?
Miles tiptoes through, looking warily about.

value.name: Miles confronts Joe unexpectedly
value.description: Miles backs into the kitchen area and suddenly finds Joe standing in front of him.
evidence: He backs through the swinging doors connecting to the kitchen. Finds himself face to face with Joe.
MILES Joe! Thank God you're in time.

value.name: Miles tries to cancel the hit
value.description: Miles tells Joe the plan is off and urges him to leave, pretending the contract no longer matters.
evidence: MILES It's a no go! Get it? No one any the wiser. Okay!
MILES You can go home now! Goodbye! Thanks so much!
MILES No no! No contract! It's all over.

value.name: Joe prepares his gun
value.description: Joe ignores Miles and takes out his gun, beginning to unscrew the silencer.
evidence: Joe takes out his gun.
This has no effect on Joe who is unscrewing his silencer.

value.name: Marylin interrupts the confrontation
value.description: Marylin appears and tells Joe the job is off, revealing she is now the one employing him.
evidence: Suddenly -- Marylin appears.
MARYLIN It's a no go, Joe.
MILES Wait! He works for YOU?
MARYLIN Now. But first, he worked for you.

value.name: Marylin blames Miles for hiring Joe
value.description: Marylin accuses Miles of sending Joe there and causing the whole situation.
evidence: MILES You were going to have this thug...?
MARYLIN Wait just a second there. You sent him here. You unearthed this pestilence.

value.name: Marylin apologizes and retracts the hit
value.description: Marylin apologizes to Joe, says they changed their minds, and asks Miles whether his earlier phone call was sincere.
evidence: MARYLIN (To Joe) I'm sorry. That was unkind and -- but, we changed our minds.
MARYLIN (To Miles) Did you really mean what you said on the phone. It wasn't because you found out about Rex?

value.name: Miles claims entitlement to Rex's money
value.description: Miles insists he meant what he said and argues that as Marylin's husband he would still be entitled to Rex's money.
evidence: MILES Nonono. Marylin -- I'm your husband. I'd be entitled to Rex's money. No matter what happened to you.
MARYLIN That's true.

value.name: Joe insults Miles as pestilence
value.description: Joe mocks Miles, calling him the pestilence and boasting that he is the exterminator.
evidence: JOE Lemme tell you something. You are the pestilence. I'm the exterminator.
